Submits a locator LED state change request (On or Off) for supported Cisco Intersight devices: Fabric Interconnects, UCS-X Chassis, Servers, Unified Edge Chassis, and Unified Edge eCMC. Prerequisites: select an Intersight target whose runtime user can read organizations, server settings, chassis identity data, chassis operations, switch operations, and related network elements, and can update locator LED settings. The workflow requires exactly one device-name match in the specified organization and fails safely for invalid inputs, lookup and helper-activity errors, non-2xx API responses, missing identity data, or a returned hardware subtype that does not match Device Type. A successful run confirms that Cisco Intersight accepted the update request; it does not poll device-side operation status or verify the physical LED state.
